selected_module.manufacturer: Guangdong Ruixin Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. (ReSine PS)

pinout.3: CTRL (leave open/high impedance for normal enabled operation)
pinout.5: NC (must not connect to any external circuit)

selected_module.source_notes: The ReSine datasheet is the manufacturer document linked by the C20617261 JLC product listing and identifies Guangdong Ruixin Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. / resineps.com. WRA2412S-3WR2 is a vendor-colliding MPN: do not substitute a MORNSUN or other vendor's same-named module. The JLC attribute card advertises 3 kV isolation while the exact ReSine datasheet specifies 1.5 kVDC; all design evidence uses the datasheet's conservative 1.5 kVDC value.

approved_design_assumption.rationale: The brief specifies rails but no load. An equal 100 mA on each rail is explicit, exceeds the 12.5 mA minimum-load requirement, and remains below the 125 mA rating. Equal loading avoids relying on undocumented asymmetric dual-output behavior.

constructive_circuit.isolation_policy: VIN_RET (pin 1) and ISO_COM (pin 7) are distinct nets. No input/output bond is fitted; a system bond, if required, is a separate reviewed requirement.
input_path: 24V_IN -> F1 slow-blow input fuse -> L_IN 10 uH -> U1 pin 2 (VIN)
CIN1 10 uF / 100 V and CIN2 1 uF / 100 V connect directly from the post-L_IN VIN node to VIN_RET.
output_paths: U1 pin 6 (+VO) -> CS_POS 22 uF / 50 V to ISO_COM -> L_POS 10 uH -> +12V_OUT. COUT_POS 100 uF / 50 V connects +12V_OUT to ISO_COM.
U1 pin 8 (-VO) -> CS_NEG 22 uF / 50 V to ISO_COM -> L_NEG 10 uH -> -12V_OUT. COUT_NEG 100 uF / 50 V connects -12V_OUT to ISO_COM.
U1 pin 7 (0V) -> ISO_COM -> J_OUT pin 2; +12V_OUT -> J_OUT pin 1; -12V_OUT -> J_OUT pin 3.

unconnected_pins.3: CTRL: open/high impedance enables the converter
unconnected_pins.5: NC: manufacturer explicitly prohibits an external connection

fabrication_sourcing_status.policy: The assembly and retail inventories both exceed the 100-unit production stock floor. Recheck dynamic stock at stage-commit time.

deterministic_verification: Run the #18 reference input through architecture, recipe/lowering, BOM/wiring, and stage-commit. Inspect its net graph for U1.1->U1.2 input path, U1.6 -> CS_POS -> L_POS -> +12V_OUT -> J_OUT.1, U1.8 -> CS_NEG -> L_NEG -> -12V_OUT -> J_OUT.3, and U1.7 -> ISO_COM -> J_OUT.2. Assert U1.1/VIN_RET has no direct path to U1.7/ISO_COM, pins 3 and 5 are explicit no-connects, each rail has 122 uF < 470 uF output capacitance, and the exact ReSine C20617261 module and WJ126V-5.0-3P terminal are in the BOM. Then run normal ERC, DRC, synthesis, and artifact checks.
